summary: Background reading before using AAPS: what an artificial pancreas and hybrid closed loop are, where AAPS comes from, its components and advantages, comparisons with other systems, safety, how to talk to the clinical team, why the app must be self-built, how it connects and is developed, and accessibility for blind users. Mostly concepts; few app labels.

sections.summary: The parts of the system: the self-built app on an Android phone, a CGM app, the pump, the oref0/oref1 algorithm and a reporting server.

sections.heading: What are the advantages of the AAPS system?
sections.summary: Overall benefits of AAPS, including automations and fine-tuning.

sections.heading: Specific advantages include:
sections.summary: Heading for the list of specific advantages.

sections.heading: 1) Safety built-in
sections.summary: Safety features of the oref algorithms; the user sets the limits.

sections.heading: 2) Hardware flexibility
sections.summary: AAPS works with many pumps and sensors, switched in the app, and has a virtual pump for trying it out.

sections.heading: 3) Highly customisable, with wide parameters
sections.summary: Examples of what can be customised: lower targets before meals, automation rules switching profile percentage, suspending insulin, SMB and UAM limited to daytime.

sections.heading: 4) Remote monitoring
sections.summary: Monitoring apps for followers (Sugarmate, Dexcom Follow, xDrip, Android Auto).

sections.heading: 5) Remote control
sections.summary: Followers can send commands by SMS or from Nightscout or AAPSClient, and from some watches.

sections.heading: 6) No commercial constraints, due to open application interfaces
sections.summary: Open source code and interfaces; close integration with Nightscout.

sections.heading: 7) Detailed app interface
sections.summary: What the app lets the user track (reservoir, cannula and sensor age, IOB) and do (prime, disconnect) without touching the pump.

sections.heading: 8) Accessibility and affordability
sections.summary: AAPS is free; a Nightscout account is needed for setup.

sections.heading: 9) Support
sections.summary: Community support on Facebook, Discord and GitHub.

sections.heading: 10) Predictability, transparency and safety
sections.summary: AAPS shows what it does and why, so settings are easier to check.

sections.heading: 11) Access to advanced features through development (dev) modes including full closed loop
sections.summary: The master and development branches; dev modes for full closed loop.

sections.heading: 12) Ability to contribute yourself to further improvements
sections.summary: Users can help others and contribute to the project.
